title: Fong Nan Woo

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 158
Date 9/3/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

March 9th 1916.

Sir,
General Fong Nan Woo 方咸五 arrived from Nanking at the Arsenal at 2 p.m. 8th instant. It is said that he has come here for the purpose of investigating the local military situation. It is also reported that he will try to float a loan, and he may enter into negotiations with the Consular Body with a view to establishing a Court where cases appealed from the Mixed Court will be tried. General Fong had a conference yesterday with Yang Tcheng Commissioner for Foreign Affairs, Director Li Tsong Nyoh 李宗岳 of the Arsenal and General Yang. General Fong will visit Woosung to-day.
In consequence of a rumour that the Central Government intends to mortgage the taxes on wine and tobacco to foreigners, the Shanghai Chamber of Commerce has sent a strongly worded telegram objecting to such a course to Chiangchun Peng of Nanking for transmission to the Central Government.

Your Obedient Servant,

mmmmmmustang

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
page_data.zh:
刑事调查处
情报官登记册
第 158 号
日期 1916年3月9日

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科）

1916年3月9日。

先生：

方咸五将军于本月8日下午2时从南京抵达兵工厂。据说他来此的目的是调查本地军事局势。另有报告称，他将尝试募集一笔贷款，并可能与领事团进行谈判，以期设立一个审理来自会审公廨上诉案件的法庭。方将军昨日与外交特派员杨贞、兵工厂总监李宗岳以及杨将军举行了会议。方将军将于今日前往吴淞。

鉴于有谣言称中央政府打算将酒税和烟草税抵押给外国人，上海总商会已向南京的章宗彭发送了一份措辞强烈的电报，反对这种做法，请其转呈中央政府。

您忠实的仆人，

mmmmmmustang

首席侦探督察长。

警务处巡官队长。
